upstream.required_model_setting: ground_truth_enabled=true; preserve the original WAM-V physics and H thrusters

operating_envelope.frame: Frozen native-odometry start; along axis is initial yaw, cross axis is its left normal
operating_envelope.violation_definition: Count entries outside this closed coordinate rectangle in received task observations; no collision or energy claim

reference.model: Ideal 2D point kinematics with instantaneous velocity along the start-to-goal line; no WAM-V thrust, turning, waves or drag dynamics
reference.comparison_boundary: The realized start, yaw, goal, nominal speed, arrival radius, observed hold rule, time budget and envelope are shared; dynamics are deliberately different
